## Clinical Experience

### Emergency Medical Technician  
**Brown EMS and Warren Fire Department**

As an emergency medical technician, I lead and assisted patient assessment, treatment, transport, and documentation in pre-hospital settings. This work strengthened my ability to communicate with patients, collaborate with a team of
responders, adapt to rapidly changing circumstances, and remain composed under pressure.

## Research Experience

### Undergraduate Research Assistant  
**Brown University**

My undergraduate research experience in experimental biological physics introduced me to interdisciplinary scientific investigation. I participated in laboratory work involving biological systems, quantitative measurements, data collection, analysis, and scientific communication.


## Education and Community Service

### English for Speakers of Other Languages Instructor

In this role, I supported adult learners as they developed their English communication skills. This experience taught me to explain unfamiliar ideas clearly, adapt to individual learning needs, and create an encouraging environment for students from different backgrounds.

### Elementary Education

I have also worked with elementary-school students, including supporting STEM education. These experiences
strengthened my patience, organization, and ability to communicate information in an accessible way.

## Music

### Classical Vocalist and Chorister  
**Brown University**

I studied voice in the applied music program at Brown. There, I also performed in the Brown University Chorus. My musical studies culminated in a capstone recital, which combined my favorite pieces from voice study.
